name: steering-audit-suite
description: Agent Skills that audit the documents prescribing agent behaviour: audit-rule for always-on rules (CLAUDE.md, steering files, system prompts), audit-skill for invocable skills (with a portability and graceful-degradation pass), audit-workflow for multi-step procedures (with phase-boundary checks), audit-collection for a directory of related documents (with split/join/merge/clone/reformat proposals), and rule-audit, the standalone single-file form. They catch behaviour-vs-surface failures, example-as-definition, embedded swipes, escape hatches, performative compliance, hidden dependencies and the rest of a 15-check list, compare against vendor-published exemplars, and report findings for the document's owner without rewriting anything. The main skill classifies a document and routes it, and holds the shared references.
